notes: ZEN VARIANT of the sibling config, pointed at opencode Zen (baseURL https://opencode.ai/zen/v1) instead of api.openai.com. Set OPENAI_API_KEY to the Zen key and OPENAI_BASE_URL to that same baseURL: bin/_akm_eval_cli_image.sh forwards both into the CLI container, and the LongMemEval evaluator reads them directly. Uses the PAID qwen3.5-plus, the same model as the akm-bench A/B runs, so numbers are at least internally comparable with those. The free tier was dropped because it rate-limits under concurrent load and its judging quality is unknown.

`judging` here is inert: nothing under src/ reads it. LoCoMo scores with the official F1 evaluator (no LLM). LongMemEval shells out to scripts/longmemeval-evaluator.py, which builds its own client from OPENAI_BASE_URL + OPENAI_API_KEY and uses packs[0].config.evaluatorModel -- so THAT is the field to change to move the judge, not this block.

Three arms over the identical provider/model/judging config in locomo-smoke.json — `memory.backend` is the only variant-level delta, but `baseline` and the two retrieval arms (`raw-vector`, `akm`) also differ in PROMPT CONSTRUCTION: baseline gets the full conversation truncated to maxContextTokens (a long-context reference, not a null/no-memory arm), while the retrieval arms get only the top-topK retrieved snippets. Do not read `baseline` as a no-memory control without accounting for this.
The akm arm needs the real akm CLI reachable (AKM_EVAL_AKM_CMD, default ["akm"]); see docs/memory-backends.md.

The akm backend's declared frontmatter-synthesis rule sets a retrieval ceiling: only the synthesized description/tags/heading are searchable, never full body prose. A fixed deterministic stopword-strip is applied to each query before it reaches akm's conjunctive-AND FTS, and the run's result.json.metadata records a zeroHitQueries/retrievalQueryCount counter — check it before publishing a number: a low score can mean akm's retrieval structurally could not answer the query, not that retrieval quality is bad.
